resources.string: Asked alongside IntroDB, AniSkip and Anime-Skip. Each source gets a few seconds; one that is slow or down never delays the others. Matching segments from several sources are combined.
Community intro, recap, credits and preview times. Needs the video length, so it answers once playback knows it.
Intro, recap and credits times for movies and series. A key is optional.
Intro and credits times. Works only with your own key.
Required. Stored encrypted on this TV for this profile.
Optional. Stored encrypted on this TV for this profile.
Paste the key from the provider\'s website. It is stored encrypted on this TV for this profile and only sent to that provider. Type clear to remove it.
Movie scene lists for content warnings, some marked to mute instead of skip.
Community skip files, found by title. Can mark scenes to skip, mute or warn about.
Jump-scare times for movies, from notscare.me.
Off until you switch a category on. These segments show the skip button, or mute the sound where the source says so; they are never skipped automatically.
